## Scope

Reconcile the retained original batch index `geo3-next-full-batch-318.json` (SHA-256 `9857d3c03f94799b4e7e22c9afce68259dc4e2747d2864d6eb580030222f3430`) against current accepted decisions, live claims, and existing source evidence. The complete roster has 318 exact component IDs across 122 family locators in BRN, IDN, IND, KHM, MMR, MYS, PHL, THA, TLS, and VNM. Keep the full index, family-to-component mapping, source-product registry, and source custody in the owned packet.

## Acceptance

- Preserve all 318 component IDs in the exact component-state ledger and retain all 122 family locators and the complete source/product context from the pinned batch index. The evidence contract binds the 30 prioritized source-geometry subjects for detailed review.
- Reconcile every exact ID against current accepted/repaired decisions and canonical claim ownership. Reuse the existing first-pass/catalog and source-comparison outputs; do not rerun unchanged source overlays.
- For each of the 30 already prioritized source-supported component IDs, bind the original source product actually used, supporting source record/feature, complete retained pointset, current target record/location, source and target IDs, geometry hashes and existing comparison evidence. State which source-product/current-target facts are established, partial, or unavailable so engineering can assess a repair.
- Preserve every other component's prior accepted/unresolved/partial state with an exact-ID reason and next action. Do not infer a physical class, cause, water/ice status, administrative authority, or repair from geometric contact or a source label. Uncertainty remains explicit.
- Do not create subbatch/per-gap issues, perform a worldwide audit, change core geography, activate native data, or write to provider/database/production/publisher/deployment/browser systems.
- Deliver the packet through normal source review, PR, merge/readback and issue reconciliation. A source-evidence result is not a repair or publication approval.

## Continuation scope — original physical-query custody

PR #1645 completed the first source-evidence phase. The next single PR continues this same 318-ID/122-family batch and the same 30 priority subjects; it does not create another batch or issue. Planning estimate: one focused source-evidence PR.

- Authenticate and preserve the original complete physical comparison/query rows behind the 30 cases using the immutable pointers in the whole-batch handoff native-geo3-318-engineering-handoff-20261009.json (SHA-256 b5949b9643083a0759933df32690cf2193ed5ea24756d36909c4576d2fc7422b). Include the original provenance record, full component geometry record, physical land-source-fitness row, administrative query row, and full existing comparison row with their source descriptor hashes, record ordinals, offsets and genuine report/hash/query provenance.
- Reuse original complete bytes and records; do not rerun source comparisons, overlays, or operators. If a pointed-to original descriptor is unavailable, report that exact descriptor and preserve the residual as unresolved.
- Keep the original physical candidate geometry distinct from an administrative target_record. Engineering owns selected current-owner, ordinal/parent, native-cell and uncovered-cell bindings. This handoff grants no repair, physical-class, water/ice, cause, authority, or publication approval.
- Preserve all 318 states, the 122-family roster and the other 288 cases' existing limitations. Do not create subbatch/per-gap issues or broaden into a worldwide audit.
